lines.text: The mutual link between national security and economic prosperity.
The prayer of Ibrahim, peace be upon him, and Makkah becoming a global centre of trade.
Peace. Prosperity. And where they meet: the survival of the state.
Ibrahim, peace be upon him, asked for two things in a barren valley:
One: make this city a city of peace. National security.
Two: provide its people with the sustenance of fruits. Economic prosperity.
Security without an economy: the system cannot stand.
An economy without security: investments and assets are not safe.
On the map, trade routes run from Makkah to Europe, Sham, Yemen and Africa.
The economic model of Makkah: it became a global trade pipeline and a highway rest stop.
The Quran formally recognised this economic route in Surah Quraysh.
